releaseNotes.headline: Claude, Cursor, and Grok Build, built in
releaseNotes.summary: Version 0.2.8 shows Claude Code, Cursor, and Grok Build limits beside Codex, each with its own logo, and reads the Claude sign-in only when you turn it on.

highlights.title: Claude Code limits, on your terms
highlights.detail: Turn on Read Claude Code sign-in under Manage AI Tools to see your session and weekly windows. Off by default, so nothing asks for Keychain access unless you want Claude.

highlights.title: Cursor and Grok Build limits
highlights.detail: Cursor’s plan usage per model pool and Grok Build’s included credits, each with its reset date, read from the sign-ins already on your Mac.

highlights.title: Every tool wears its own mark
highlights.detail: Claude, Cursor, Grok Build, and Gemini rows show their logos in the rail, Settings, and the detail popover, matching the ChatGPT mark.
